title: Evaluating GPT-3 Generated Explanations for Hateful Content Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting GPT-3 to generate explanations for hateful and non-hateful tweets (involving attacks based on race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, or sexual orientation) and utilizing human evaluators to assess the text for fluency, informativeness, persuasiveness, and logical soundness.

Comparing human evaluators' hatefulness classifications of tweets with and without prior exposure to GPT-3 generated explanations to measure if the model's output incorrectly persuades or misleads human moderators.
